AreaCreate.description: Create an area at the end.
AreaCreate.title: AreaCreate

CalendarRangeOut.description: The events that appear in a range and their occurrences there, in start order.
CalendarRangeOut.title: CalendarRangeOut

CollectionCreate.description: Create a collection at the end; send a client ``id`` for idempotent, optimistic creates.
CollectionCreate.title: CollectionCreate

CollectionMove.description: Reorder a collection between two neighbours (either may be omitted).
CollectionMove.title: CollectionMove

DeletedOut.description: What a (cascading) soft delete or its restore touched.
DeletedOut.title: DeletedOut

EntryCreate.description: Create an entry; send a client-generated ``id`` for idempotent, optimistic creates.
EntryCreate.title: EntryCreate

EntryOut.description: A note, link or snippet. ``collection_id`` null means Unsorted.

body.description: Note text, link description or snippet code.
body.title: Body

EntryOut.title: EntryOut

EntryPatch.description: Partial update: absent fields stay unchanged, ``null`` clears (language, collection).
EntryPatch.title: EntryPatch

EventCreate.description: Create an event. Give ``start_at``/``end_at`` or, with ``all_day``, the dates.
EventCreate.title: EventCreate

EventOut.description: An event; with ``rrule`` it is a recurring series anchored at its start.
EventOut.title: EventOut

EventPatch.description:
Change an event. Absent fields stay; ``rrule: null`` stops repeating.

For a recurring event, ``scope`` picks what changes: ``all`` (the series),
``this`` or ``following`` (both need ``occurrence_date``; timing fields
then describe that occurrence). ``split_id`` names the event split off.
EventPatch.title: EventPatch

EventsOut.description: Every event a request touched (a series and the event split off it).
EventsOut.title: EventsOut

HealthOut.description:
Liveness and schema state.

Attributes:
    status: ``ok`` when the database answers.
    version: Application version.
    schema_versions: Highest applied migration per owner (``core``, module ids).
HealthOut.title: HealthOut

KnowledgeDeletedOut.description: What a delete (or its restore) touched; restore by id to undo.
KnowledgeDeletedOut.title: KnowledgeDeletedOut

LinkCreate.description: Link two entities; send a client-generated ``id`` for idempotent, optimistic creates.

source.description: Entity reference of the linking item.
source.title: Source

target.description: Entity reference of the linked item.
target.title: Target

LinkCreate.title: LinkCreate

LinkDeletedOut.description: Result of a soft delete; restore by id to undo.
LinkDeletedOut.title: LinkDeletedOut

deleted.description: True when the entity is deleted (or no longer known).
deleted.title: Deleted

LinkOut.description: A link with both ends summarised.
LinkOut.title: LinkOut

ListCreate.description: Create a list at the end of its area.
ListCreate.title: ListCreate

ListMove.description: Reorder a list and/or move it to another area (``area_id`` is required, may be null).
ListMove.title: ListMove

ListOut.description: A list; ``area_id`` is null for lists outside any area.
ListOut.title: ListOut

LogbookOut.description: A page of completed todos, newest first; pass ``next_cursor`` for the next page.
LogbookOut.title: LogbookOut

MetaOut.description:
Facts the frontend needs to agree with the backend.

Attributes:
    version: Application version.
    mode: ``serve``, ``dev`` or ``test``.
    timezone: IANA zone that defines "today".
    week_starts_on: ISO weekday the week starts on (1 = Monday).
    can_shutdown: Whether the app may stop the server (daily-use launcher only).
MetaOut.title: MetaOut

OccurrenceOut.description: One appearance of an event; ``occurrence_date`` is its local start date (the key).
OccurrenceOut.title: OccurrenceOut

Problem.description:
An RFC 9457 problem document.

Attributes:
    type: URI reference identifying the problem type (``about:blank`` here).
    title: Short, human-readable summary of the problem type.
    status: The HTTP status code.
    detail: Explanation specific to this occurrence.
    code: Stable machine-readable code, e.g. ``not_found``.
    errors: Field-level details for validation problems.
Problem.title: Problem

Rename.description: Rename an area, list or section.
Rename.title: Rename

hint.description: Short context from the owning module, e.g. 'Done · Groceries'.
hint.title: Hint

snippet.description: An excerpt of the text around the match, marked like the title (empty when the item has no text).
snippet.title: Snippet

title.description: The title; matched terms sit between U+E000 and U+E001.
title.title: Title

SectionCreate.description: Create a section in a list (at the end unless neighbours are given).
SectionCreate.title: SectionCreate

SectionMove.description: Reorder a section; another ``list_id`` takes its todos along.
SectionMove.title: SectionMove

ShutdownIn.description:
Body of a shutdown request.

Requiring a JSON body means a plain HTML form or a "simple" cross-site
request cannot trigger a shutdown.

Attributes:
    confirm: Must be ``true``.
ShutdownIn.title: ShutdownIn

ShutdownOut.description:
Acknowledgement; the server stops right after sending it.

Attributes:
    status: Always ``stopping``.
ShutdownOut.title: ShutdownOut

TagCreate.description: Create a tag; send a client-generated ``id`` for idempotent, optimistic creates.
TagCreate.title: TagCreate

TagDeletedOut.description: Result of a soft delete; restore by id to undo.
TagDeletedOut.title: TagDeletedOut

TodayOrder.description: The todos of one group in Today, top to bottom.
TodayOrder.title: TodayOrder

TodoCreate.description: Create a todo or subtask (at the end of its container unless neighbours are given).
TodoCreate.title: TodoCreate

TodoMove.description: Place a todo: the three container fields are required (each may be null).
TodoMove.title: TodoMove

TodoOut.description:
A todo; ``parent_id`` set means it is a subtask; ``list_id`` null means Inbox.

A repeating todo has an ``rrule`` (RFC 5545, without ``DTSTART``) whose
series starts on ``recurrence_anchor``. ``today_position`` is its place in
Today's manual order (null until Today is reordered, and after the due
date changes).
TodoOut.title: TodoOut

TodoPatch.description:
Change fields of a todo. Absent fields stay; ``due_date: null`` clears the date.

``rrule`` starts (or changes) a repeat anchored on the due date (today if
none); ``rrule: null`` stops it, and so does clearing the due date.
TodoPatch.title: TodoPatch

TodosOut.description: Every todo a request changed (e.g. a parent and its subtasks).
TodosOut.title: TodosOut
